title: Cloud Security Attack Checklist
description: AK/SK credentials, metadata, buckets, and container registries
detail:
1. Credential sources: hardcoded in code (.env/config.py), build artifacts, git history, metadata endpoints
2. AK/SK usage: Alibaba Cloud (ossutil/aliyun CLI to list resources), AWS (start with aws sts get-caller-identity), Tencent Cloud (COS/cloud APIs)
3. Metadata: 169.254.169.254 provider-specific paths (see the SSRF entry); Alibaba Cloud's newer IMDS requires a token (fetch it first, then query)
4. Buckets: public listing, arbitrary upload (PUT), serverless function modification; URL patterns *.oss-*.aliyuncs.com / *.cos.ap-*.myqcloud.com / *.s3.amazonaws.com
5. Image registries: Harbor unauthenticated (/api/v2.0/), Docker registry 5000 API to list images → mine credentials from layers
6. Kubernetes: kubelet 10250 unauthenticated exec, dashboard, etcd 2379
Common end goals in cloud assessments: read sensitive proof artifacts from RDS/object storage, or use credentials to launch instances and obtain metadata proof artifacts.
